name: GitHub
description:
The real GitHub REST API. Public data such as users, repositories and search works without signing in, limited to 60 requests an hour.

For more (5,000 an hour, or private data), create a personal access token on GitHub and add an Authorization header with the value "Bearer" followed by your token. Keep the token in an environment variable rather than in a saved request.
